findings.summary: Two methods on `CommandRegistry` are never called anywhere in the repo: `has_command` (impl line 37, declared at `jac/jaclang/cli/registry.jac:19`) and `get_groups` (impl line 53, declared at `registry.jac:24`). Evidence: a repo-wide grep for `has_command` returns exactly two hits — the declaration and this impl — with no `.has_command(` call site in any `.jac`, `.py`, or test file. A repo-wide grep for `get_groups` returns hits only for a *different*, module-level `get_groups` in `jac/jaclang/cli/manifest.jac:83` (implemented at `jac/jaclang/cli/impl/manifest.impl.jac:2219`, consumed by `jac/jaclang/cli/impl/mcp_manifest.impl.jac:9`) — no `registry.get_groups()` / `.get_groups(` call reaches the `CommandRegistry` method. The sibling `CommandRegistry.get_all` is genuinely live (`jac/jaclang/cli/gen_cli_manifest.jac:54`), so the object itself stays. Removal is a paired edit: drop both impls here and both stubs in `registry.jac`.
